courses_data.course_3_v1_title: Session 1: Introduction to Philosophy of Science
courses_data.course_1_desc: This module introduces the basic principles, methods, and theories within digital design and communication. Through a combination of theoretical discussions and practical design exercises, students learn to analyze, conceptualize, and design interactive digital artifacts. Special focus will be placed on user-centered design processes, prototyping, and evaluation methods in real-world scenarios.
courses_data.course_2_desc: This course covers advanced web development with a focus on modern front-end technologies and Content Management Systems (CMS). Students will acquire deep knowledge of semantic HTML, CSS layout techniques (Flexbox and Grid), and building reactive web applications using React. The course covers component-driven development, state management, and integration with external data sources and REST APIs.
courses_data.course_3_desc: Philosophy of Science is an introductory course to the philosophy of science, scientific methods, and epistemology. The course presents the most significant philosophical currents and positions, including positivism, critical rationalism (Popper), scientific paradigms (Kuhn), and hermeneutics. The purpose is to provide students with tools for critical reflection on scientific practice and methodology.
